'''Thanek''' was the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Director of Agriculture]] of the [[Rysais Producers Co-operative]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. He was answering directly to the [[Bothan/Legends|Botan]] [[Consul of Natural Resources]].
